notes.title: Two new weapons update
notes.notes: This update has a few small bug fixes, and most importantly, the job rewards have been updated. The Flare Gun will no longer be given as a possible reward, but the Revolver and two new weapons are in the rotation. The new weapons are an alternate shotgun and an alternate SMG. While the original SMG is suppressed, the new one is not. The new shotgun has a wider spread and less ammo capacity.

notes.title: June 19 Patch - Continue
notes.notes:
This update will please anyone who has not had the time to play through all 3 levels of the demo in one sitting. When you clear a level, the next level to play will be stored and you can continue to that level on a later playthrough.

Also, if you accidentally click New Game, don't worry, as long as you don't beat level 1 you can just exit out and Continue will still function.
